milestones.title: Establish repository contracts and test-first gates
milestones.outcome: An engineer can build a small contract fixture, observe a real red/green test, reject a forbidden import, and compile the same wire values in TypeScript and Swift.

milestones.title: Qualify isolated verification and trusted evidence
milestones.outcome: An engineer drives both real applications through their CLIs and cannot obtain a passing trusted result from forged or missing proof.

milestones.title: Prove independently recoverable backup and restore
milestones.outcome: An operator restores the foundation on a separate host, proves its data and fences the old instance.

milestones.title: Qualify the selected React production client
milestones.outcome: A user navigates a large room and failure/recovery cards in a responsive accessible client without authority confusion.

milestones.title: Invite developers into scoped project rooms
milestones.outcome: Two invited humans sign in and see only rooms they may read; an owner can revoke a member and see active access end.

milestones.title: Deliver durable conversation and ordered reconnection
milestones.outcome: Two developers converse and search the same ordered history after reconnecting without duplicate messages or lost edits.

milestones.title: Answer questions with visible read-only agent sessions
milestones.outcome: A developer asks the center about a recorded decision and receives a cited answer without giving the agent execution or private-room authority.

milestones.title: Create owned tasks with fenced runs and approvals
milestones.outcome: A human confirms one bounded task; fake competing workers cannot both own it, and expired authority stays unusable.

milestones.title: Connect owner-bound workers and prepare clean worktrees
milestones.outcome: The launching developer connects a worker without inbound ports and receives an isolated task worktree while their normal checkout stays unchanged.

milestones.title: Execute bounded local work and collect behavior evidence
milestones.outcome: One real provider-backed task changes the fixture application, proves its user flow, and returns digest-verified evidence without host credential access.

milestones.title: Publish approved drafts and enforce independent review
milestones.outcome: The second developer approves an exact result, the owner publishes a draft, and GitHub blocks merge until independent review and trusted current-head checks pass.

milestones.title: Prove the first release across two accounts and machines
milestones.outcome: Two developers complete the entire conversation-to-local-task-to-human-reviewed-result workflow and an operator can restore the center.

milestones.title: Provision a private project from a conversation
milestones.outcome: An owner sees one repository and room with a truthful onboarding checkpoint; this milestone does not wait for future image/cloud units to activate the complete project.

milestones.title: Build and qualify declarative project images
milestones.outcome: A maintainer builds an approved project environment and can reproduce it after deleting its cache.

milestones.title: Execute and recover one isolated cloud attempt
milestones.outcome: A human launches a cloud task in a fresh microVM and sees evidence and confirmed destruction, or a precise unresolved cleanup state.

milestones.title: Activate persistent project agents and reviewed knowledge
milestones.outcome: A project main agent answers after restart with cited approved decisions, and stale/disputed knowledge no longer enters operational context.

milestones.title: Prove local and cloud execution parity
milestones.outcome: A developer chooses local or cloud explicitly and receives the same trustworthy review contract, while placement-specific trust and cost remain visible.

milestones.title: Qualify a real external coding-agent adapter
milestones.outcome: A developer can use one qualified existing coding agent without granting it new authority.

milestones.title: Deliver the native Swift client without worker authority
milestones.outcome: Two developers use a real native Mac client for the same human-governed workflow without acquiring local execution authority.

milestones.title: Capture observer proposals and promote reviewed knowledge
milestones.outcome: A project conversation produces reviewable, attributed knowledge proposals without automatic truth or cross-project disclosure.

milestones.title: Harden operations and prove governed deletion
milestones.outcome: An operator can recover the center and explain every retained, deleted, or unresolved resource without hidden authority.

milestones.title: Add an opt-in notification-only Slack bridge
milestones.outcome: A requested Slack channel receives one approved notification linking to the authoritative Agora record, without becoming another control plane.
